protocol: Test distinct count/list stability and forced pageSize=1 for attribute-only manifests, then exact-ID raw full-geometry batches with count-before/data/count-after.

designCandidateForReview.mode: opt-in distinct-native-ID manifest plus complete raw-row geometry validation
designCandidateForReview.manifest: Use returnCountOnly=true and returnDistinctValues=true with outFields=idlote and returnGeometry=false; require count to equal the distinct attribute manifest length, unique IDs, stable pre/post counts, and a complete bounded pageSize=1 ID set when pagination is supported.
designCandidateForReview.geometry: For each bounded exact native-ID batch, count raw matching rows before geometry, fetch un-distinct full geometry with safe idlote only, then count again; require response row count to equal both counts, no transfer-limit flag, only requested IDs, and repeatable reads.
designCandidateForReview.duplicateRule: Group raw full geometries by idlote and collapse only if every complete full native polygon hash for that ID is identical; fail closed on conflicting hashes, incomplete geometry, count drift, truncation, missing/extra IDs, or unstable repeat hashes.
designCandidateForReview.absenceRule: Require an absent ID count of zero and an empty, untruncated geometry response.
designCandidateForReview.scope: Opt-in mode only; default strict duplicate-object-ID rejection remains unchanged.
